purpose: Schema for the future diagnostic artifact backend/architecture/phase4f_6/e0_diagnostics/diagnostics/runtime_validation.json. This file defines fields and status vocabulary ONLY — no runtime results are populated now because no PostgreSQL/pgvector runtime exists (state: WAITING_FOR_MEDIA).

postgres_version.constraint: server major must be within asyncpg 0.30.0 supported range 9.5-17; value recorded from SELECT version() at runtime, never asserted beforehand

pgvector_version.constraint: server-side extension version from pg_extension.extversion — not the Python client 0.5.0; capability acceptance (vector, vector(384), cosine <=>)

host.constraint: localhost only; remote/cloud host = failure condition

database.constraint: must equal documind_e0_diagnostic; production documind never contacted

role.constraint: dedicated diagnostic role where feasible, else justification recorded

isolation_verified.method: 5-step pre-SQL proof (E0_OFFLINE_RUNTIME_PROVISIONING.md section 4), recorded before any SQL

vector_384_verified.method: CREATE TEMP TABLE _t(v vector(384)); DROP TABLE _t;

asyncpg_verified.method: asyncpg==0.30.0 connect to diagnostic DSN then SELECT 1

embedding_verified.constraint: offline re-verification of all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-dim, network_needed=false) as resume step 9; prior evidence in diagnostics/embedding_offline_verification.json is not copied here

schema_verified.method: created via existing Base.metadata.create_all pattern against the diagnostic engine; actual table/column/type inventory reconciled against e0_diagnostics/retrieval_schema_requirements.json

corpus_documents.constraint: count AND document_sha256 per record AND source fingerprint 3ec81cc5... must match; any drift = BLOCKED

corpus_chunks.constraint: unique chunk_id, sequence ordering, structural metadata, offsets sidecar, chunk fingerprint e6965cda... must match

smoke_questions.expected: 3-5 answerable (category diversity: DIRECT_SPAN, NUMERIC, TABLE_CELL/TABLE_ROW, LIST_ITEM, MULTI_CHUNK/SECTION_SPECIFIC) + exactly 1 unanswerable
smoke_questions.rule: only questions actually run are recorded here and in retrieval_traces_smoke.jsonl; never a synthetic 182-row trace; genuine scores/ranks only

retrieval_parity.constraint: same retrieval function, SQL, embedding model, 384-dim, top_k=5, cosine <=>, filters, ordering, 1-distance similarity — only database/corpus may differ; any required code change = BLOCKED (STOP)

context_assembly.rule: recorded for smoke examples only (retrieved chunks -> ordering -> assembly -> truncation -> final model input); never claim OBSERVED when merely reconstructed

e0_ready.constraint: twelve-condition gate (4F.6-F Task 15) re-evaluated with recorded evidence; even PASS does not authorize full 182-example E0 execution — that is a separate future phase

media_fingerprints.rule: sha256 of PostgreSQL installer/archive, vector.dll, vector.control, vector--*.sql recorded BEFORE install/use per E0_RUNTIME_HANDOFF_MANIFEST.json media_fingerprint_procedure; no hashes may be asserted while media is absent

failure_rule: Any FAIL in this record forces the BLOCKED state transition in the resume state machine; UNVERIFIED means the check ran but evidence is insufficient and must not be reported as PASS.
scientific_boundary: This schema carries no retrieval-quality, bottleneck, model-superiority, or hypothesis (H-A..H-E) claims — it records runtime readiness only.
